description: Tassyir is the back office of e-commerce merchants in Algeria. Once a merchant connects their Tassyir business, ChatGPT can review sales (orders, confirmation and delivery rates, delivered revenue, ad spend, best sellers and top wilayas), work the order queue (list pending orders, confirm, cancel, schedule, assign and comment on them, dispatch confirmed orders to delivery and follow parcels until delivered or returned), manage the catalog (create and update products with sizes, colors and per-variant prices, categories and stock levels) and keep the books (record expenses and capital transactions). Every action runs with the merchant’s own Tassyir role permissions, on the one business they connected. Amounts are in Algerian dinars (DZD).

defaultPrompt: How were my sales this week? Show revenue, orders, and confirmation rate.
Show my pending orders and help me confirm them one by one.
Add a new product to my store with sizes, colors, and prices per variant.
